notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for canceling a pending negotiated ownership acquisition during resignation. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies cancellation of the negotiated request, suppression of stale divestiture or release callbacks, current-owner preservation, and standard cleanup without asserting provider-specific behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador negotiated attribute ownership divestiture, pending acquisition cancellation, and resignation services with FederateAmbassador ownership callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador negotiated ownership cancellation declarations
